theme: 全真模擬考 第 4 回

words.ex: The ceremony was rescheduled for next Sunday.
Staff can identify participants by their name tags.
The student union conducted a survey on the cafeteria.
Keep your receipt as proof of payment.
Contact your RA if you have any concerns.
The network will be down during maintenance.
Students felt more engaged without their phones.
The project includes fieldwork on boats.
You can top up your meal card online.
Quiet hours start at nine p.m. during finals.
My office hours have moved to Thursday morning.
A bird's beak inspired the design of the train.

audio.t: When does the library close during the exam period?

questions.explain: 問的是「何時關門」，(B)「大概午夜」回答時間。(A) 答地點；(C) 用 Yes 回答 When 問句，且重複 close 的字形（closed）作干擾。

audio.t: Who's in charge of the club fair this year?

options: Jenny from the student union is.
questions.explain: 問「誰負責」，(A) 指出學生會的 Jenny。(B) 利用 fair 的另一個意思（公平的）作同音干擾；(C) 回答地點。

audio.t: Would you like to join our study group for statistics?

options: I studied in the group room.
Sure, when do you usually meet?
questions.explain: 這是邀請句，(C) 接受邀請並追問聚會時間，最自然。(A) 重複 study、group 字眼但答非所問；(B) 說明開始時間，應是邀請者才知道的資訊。

audio.t: Why was the chemistry lab locked this morning?

options: They were fixing the gas pipes.
questions.explain: 問「為什麼鎖住」，(A) 說明在修瓦斯管線，提供原因。(B) 重複 lock 但是指令句；(C) 回答時間起點，不是原因。

audio.t: Should I print the report or send it by email?

options: Email is fine with Professor Lin.
questions.explain: 選擇疑問句不能用 Yes/No 回答，(C) 直接選擇「寄 email 就可以」。(A) 用 Yes 回答選擇句；(B) 回答頁數。

audio.t: How much does it cost to rent a locker for the semester?

questions.explain: How much 問價錢，(B) 回答兩百元。(A) 回答地點；(C) 用與 locker 音近的 lock 作干擾。

audio.t: Haven't you registered for the campus marathon yet?

options: The race starts at the gym.
Not yet. Is it too late?
questions.explain: 否定疑問句問「還沒報名嗎」，(C)「還沒，太晚了嗎？」最合理。(A) 只提起跑地點；(B) 用 ran 與 marathon 聯想作干擾。

audio.t: Where should I hand in my scholarship application?

questions.explain: Where 問地點，(A) 學務處是正確回答。(B) 回答期限（When）；(C) 重複 scholarship 但答非所問。

audio.t: Can you lend me your notes from Tuesday's lecture?

options: I lent it to the library.
Sorry, I missed that class too.
The lecture was in Hall B.
questions.explain: 請求借筆記，(B) 婉拒並說明自己也缺課，是合理回應。(A) 用 lent 重複 lend 的字形；(C) 只提上課地點，沒有回應請求。

audio.t: The shuttle bus is late again, isn't it?

options: Yes, there must be heavy traffic.
questions.explain: 附加問句尋求同意，(C) 表示同意並推測原因（塞車）。(A) 重複 bus；(B) 回答公車所在地點，與「誤點」無關。

audio.t: Which dorm are you moving into next semester?

options: Probably Oak Hall, near the gym.
questions.explain: Which dorm 問哪一棟宿舍，(A) 回答 Oak Hall。(B) 重複 next semester 卻回答開學時間；(C) 用 moved 重複 moving 作干擾。

audio.t: Why don't we review for the quiz at the café?

options: Good idea, it's quieter there in the morning.
questions.explain: Why don't we... 是提議，不是問原因。(B) 贊成提議最恰當。(A) 誤把它當成問原因而用 Because 回答；(C) 由 café 聯想到點咖啡。

audio.t: Hi, I'd like to book a group study room for this Thursday afternoon.
Let me check. The rooms on the second floor are full, but room four ten on the fourth floor is free from two to five.
Great. We only need it from three to five.
Okay. Please bring your student I D when you check in.

questions.prompt: Which room will the man use?
questions.explain: 館員說二樓滿了，但四樓的 room four ten（410）有空，男子接受，故選 (C)。(A) 是已滿的二樓；(B)(D) 是數字順序顛倒的干擾。

audio.t: Attention, all students in the Science Building. A fire drill will take place tomorrow at ten fifteen a.m. When the alarm sounds, please leave by the nearest stairs, not the elevators, and gather in the parking lot behind the building. The drill should last about twenty minutes.

questions.prompt: Where should students gather?
questions.explain: 廣播說 gather in the parking lot behind the building，故選 (A)。(B) 電梯是明確說不要使用的；(C) 圖書館沒有提到。

audio.t: My meal card balance is almost zero. Can I add money at the cafeteria?
Not anymore. Since this month, you have to top it up online or at the machine in the Student Center.
Oh, does the machine take credit cards?
No, cash only. For cards, you'll have to use the website.

questions.prompt: How can the woman add money using a credit card?
questions.explain: 男子說機器只收現金，用卡要上網站（use the website），故選 (D)。(A) 本月起已不能在餐廳儲值；(B) 機器只收現金；(C) 沒有提到銀行。

audio.t: Hello, this is Amy from the campus bookstore. The textbook you ordered, Introduction to Marketing, has arrived. We'll hold it for you until next Wednesday. Please note that we are closed this weekend for inventory, so come on a weekday between nine and six.

questions.prompt: What is true about the bookstore?
options: It will hold the book for a month.
It will be closed this weekend.
It is open until nine p.m.
questions.explain: 留言提到 we are closed this weekend for inventory，故選 (B)。(A) 只保留到下週三；(C) 營業時間是九點到六點，nine 是開門時間不是打烊時間。

audio.t: Before you go, a quick change. My office hours this week will move from Wednesday afternoon to Thursday morning, ten to twelve, because I'm attending a conference. If Thursday doesn't work for you, send me an email and we can meet online.

questions.prompt: Why are the office hours changing?
options: The professor will attend a conference.
Students asked for a morning time.
questions.explain: 教授說 because I'm attending a conference，故選 (A)。(B)(C) 沒有提到；(D) 利用 meet online 作干擾，線上只是無法到場者的替代方案。

audio.t: There are so many club booths! Are you joining anything?
I was going to join the hiking club, but they meet every Saturday morning, and I work then.
What about the film society? They meet on Tuesday nights.
That could work. Let's go and ask.

questions.prompt: Why might the man not join the hiking club?
questions.explain: 男子說登山社週六早上聚會，而他那時要工作（I work then），故選 (C)。(A) 他原本想參加，表示並非不喜歡；(B) 沒有提到費用。

audio.t: Good news for sports fans. Starting next month, you can reserve tennis and badminton courts through the new campus app, Campus Go. Reservations open three days in advance, and each student can book up to two hours per day. Phone reservations will no longer be accepted.

questions.prompt: What will change next month?
options: Courts will be free for students.
Courts must be booked through an app.
Students can book up to three hours a day.
questions.explain: 下個月起要用 Campus Go app 預約，且不再接受電話預約，故選 (B)。(A) 沒提到免費；(C) 每天上限是兩小時，three 是提前三天開放；(D) 沒有新球場。

audio.t: I can't connect to the campus Wi-Fi. I think my password has expired.
Passwords expire every ninety days. You can reset it on the I T website, but since you're not connected, you'll need to use a computer in the lab.
Okay. And how long does it take?
The new password usually works in about fifteen minutes.

questions.prompt: What will the man probably do next?
options: Use a computer in the lab
questions.explain: 女子說他沒有網路，必須用實驗室電腦上 IT 網站重設密碼，故選 (D)。(B) ninety days 是密碼有效期；(A)(C) 沒有提到。

audio.t: Hi everyone, a reminder from your R A. Starting next Monday, which is finals week, quiet hours will be extended. Instead of starting at eleven p.m., they will start at nine p.m. every night until the end of exams. If you want to study in groups, the lounge on the first floor will stay open twenty-four hours.

questions.prompt: What time will quiet hours begin during finals week?
questions.explain: 期末週安靜時間改為晚上九點開始，故選 (A)。(B) 是平常的時間；(C) 24 小時是指一樓交誼廳的開放時間。

audio.t: Have you asked anyone to write a recommendation letter for the scholarship?
I was going to ask Professor Wu, but she's on leave this semester.
What about Doctor Lee? You got an A in her class.
True. And she knows about my research project. I'll email her today.

questions.prompt: Who will the woman probably ask for a letter?
questions.explain: 吳教授這學期休假，女子同意找李博士並說今天就寄信給她，故選 (C)。(A) 原本的人選但不在；(B)(D) 沒有被考慮。

audio.t: Thank you for calling the University Art Museum. From November twentieth to December fifth, the museum will be closed while a new exhibition is set up. The new exhibition, Light and Shadow, opens on December sixth. Admission is free for all students and staff with a valid I D.

questions.prompt: When will the new exhibition open?
questions.explain: 錄音說新展覽 opens on December sixth，故選 (B)。(A) 是開始閉館的日期；(C) 是閉館的最後一天。

audio.t: Good afternoon, and thank you for coming. I'm Doctor Karen Fang, director of the Student Counseling Center. Many students tell us that the middle of the semester is the most stressful time, so this month we're offering a series of free workshops.

The first workshop, on time management, is on Monday evenings. The second one, on test anxiety, is on Wednesday afternoons. Both take place in the Wellness Room on the second floor of the Student Center, and each group is limited to fifteen people.
To sign up, please use the online form on our website. We don't take sign-ups by phone, because spaces fill quickly and we want to be fair to everyone.

Also, if you'd like to talk to a counselor one on one, you can now get an appointment within forty-eight hours. Last year, students sometimes had to wait two weeks. We hired three new counselors this fall to make this possible.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the talk?
options: To explain how to become a counselor
To introduce workshops and services at the counseling center
To announce a change in exam dates
To ask students to answer a survey
questions.explain: 主任介紹免費工作坊與個別諮商預約的改善，故選 (B)。(A) 沒談如何成為諮商師；(C) 提到 test anxiety 但沒有改考試日期；(D) 沒有問卷。

questions.prompt: Which TWO statements about the workshops are true? (Choose TWO.)
options: They are held in the Student Center.
Students can sign up by phone.
Each group has a limit of fifteen people.
questions.explain: 工作坊在學生活動中心二樓舉行 (A)，每組限 fifteen people (D)。(B) 工作坊免費，fifteen 是人數不是價錢；(C) 明說不接受電話報名；(E) 是週一晚上和週三下午，不是週末。

questions.prompt: Why can students now see a counselor more quickly?
options: The center is open on weekends.
questions.explain: 主任說今年秋天聘了三位新諮商師，所以 48 小時內就能預約，故選 (D)。(B) 線上表單是工作坊報名方式；(A)(C) 沒有提到。

audio.t: Come in, Yu-ting. You said you're worried about graduating on time?
Yes. I checked my record, and I still need twelve credits. I planned to take them all next spring, but I also want to do an internship then.

I see. Well, you have two choices. You could take two courses in summer school, which is six credits, and then only six credits in the spring. Or, some departments let you count an internship as three credits.
Really? Does the business department allow that?
It does, but the internship must be at least two hundred hours, and you need to get approval before it starts. The form is due at the end of January.
Then maybe I'll do both: summer school and an internship for credit.
That would leave you with only three credits for the spring. Very manageable.

questions.prompt: What is the woman's main concern?
questions.explain: 開頭導師就問 worried about graduating on time，女子說還差 12 學分，故選 (C)。(B) summer 指暑修不是暑期工作；(A)(D) 沒有提到。

questions.prompt: What is required for an internship to count for credit? (Choose TWO.)
options: It must last at least two hundred hours.
It must be in another city.
The student must have a high GPA.
Approval is needed before it starts.
questions.explain: 導師說實習至少 200 小時 (B)，且開始前要先取得核准 (E)。(A)(C)(D) 對話中都沒有提到。

questions.prompt: If the woman follows her plan, how many credits will she take in the spring?
questions.explain: 她還差 12 學分，暑修 6 學分、實習抵 3 學分，春季只剩 3 學分，導師也說 only three credits for the spring，故選 (A)。(B) 是只暑修不實習的情況；(D) 是原本的總數。

audio.t: This is Campus Wave with your weekly news. This Saturday, the Environmental Club will hold its first Second-Life Market on the sports field, from ten a.m. to four p.m. Students can sell or swap used items such as books, clothes, and small furniture.

Selling tables are free, but you must register by Thursday through the club's social media page. Food and drinks may not be sold, and electrical items must be tested at the club's booth before they can be sold.
The club hopes to cut down on the waste left behind when students move out at the end of the semester. Last June, cleaners collected nearly three tons of furniture and other items from the dorms.
If it rains, the market will move indoors to the gym, but with only half the number of tables. So register early!

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the market?
options: To raise money for the club
To reduce waste from students moving out
To sell food from local farms
questions.explain: 社團希望 cut down on the waste left behind when students move out，故選 (B)。(A) 攤位免費，沒說要募款；(C) 明確禁止賣食物；(D) 沒有提到。

questions.prompt: What must sellers do before selling electrical items?
questions.explain: 電器用品 must be tested at the club's booth，故選 (C)。(A) 報名期限是週四以前，不是週五；(B) 攤位免費；(D) 沒有提到收據。

questions.prompt: What will happen if it rains?
options: It will move to next Saturday.
questions.explain: 下雨會移到體育館，但攤位只剩一半（only half the number of tables），故選 (D)。(A)(B) 不會取消也不會延期；(C) 攤位本來就免費，無退款問題。

audio.t: Today we're going to talk about biomimicry, which means copying ideas from nature to solve human problems. Engineers have done this for a long time, but the field has grown quickly in the last thirty years.

One famous example is Velcro. In the nineteen forties, a Swiss engineer noticed that small seeds stuck to his dog's fur. Under a microscope, he saw tiny hooks on the seeds, and he used the same idea to make a fastener.

A more recent example comes from Japan. The nose of the bullet train was redesigned to look like the beak of a kingfisher, a bird that dives into water with very little splash. The new shape made the train quieter when it left tunnels, and it also used about fifteen percent less electricity.

However, biomimicry is not simply copying a shape. Designers must understand why the natural feature works. For your assignment, choose one product and explain which natural feature inspired it and why that feature works. It's due in two weeks.

questions.prompt: According to the speaker, what inspired Velcro?
options: Seeds stuck to a dog's fur
questions.explain: 講者說瑞士工程師發現種子黏在狗毛上，種子有小鉤子，因而發明魔鬼氈，故選 (A)。(B) 鳥是新幹線的例子，且是鳥喙不是羽毛；(C)(D) 沒有提到。

questions.prompt: What were the results of the new train design? (Choose TWO.)
options: The train became cheaper to build.
questions.explain: 新車頭讓列車出隧道時更安靜 (B)，且省電約 15% (D)。(A)(C)(E) 都沒有提到，(A) 是常見的想當然耳干擾。

questions.prompt: What does the speaker say students must explain in the assignment?
questions.explain: 作業要說明哪個自然特徵啟發產品、以及 why that feature works，故選 (C)。(B) 講者舉例時提到發明者，但作業沒要求；(A)(D) 沒有提到。

questions.prompt: Because of the heavy rain, the outdoor graduation ceremony has been ______ for next Sunday.
questions.explain: 句意：因大雨，戶外畢業典禮「改期」到下週日。reschedule 改期。(A) 提醒、(B) 使清新、(C) 預訂，都不符合「改到另一天」的意思。

questions.prompt: The library will ______ its opening hours during final exams, staying open until 2 a.m.
questions.explain: 延長時間用 extend，後面「開到凌晨兩點」說明時間變長。(B) expand 多指空間或規模擴大；(C) 期待；(D) 探索。

questions.prompt: All participants must wear a name tag so that staff can easily ______ them.
questions.explain: 戴名牌是為了讓工作人員「辨認」參加者，identify。(A) 暗示、(B) 激勵、(D) 使印象深刻，與名牌的功能無關。

questions.prompt: Your essay should be well ______, with a clear introduction, body, and conclusion.
questions.explain: 有清楚的引言、本文、結論，表示文章「組織良好」well organized。(A) 有機的；(C) 普通的；(D) 原創的，雖可形容文章但與後面的結構說明不搭。

questions.prompt: Students can ______ for a parking permit online starting September 1.
questions.explain: apply for 申請，搭配 permit（許可證）。(B) appeal 上訴、(C) approve 核准（是學校做的事）、(D) appear 出現。

questions.prompt: The professor gave us a ______ list of readings, but we only need to read the first three articles before the midterm.
questions.explain: but 表示轉折：書單很「長」，但期中前只要讀前三篇，故用 lengthy。(B) brief 簡短的，與 but 的語意不合；(A)(C) 不適合形容書單長度。

questions.prompt: The student union ______ a survey to find out how satisfied students are with the cafeteria.
questions.explain: conduct a survey 進行調查是固定搭配。(A) 諮詢、(C) 說服、(D) 包含，字首相近但意思不符。

questions.prompt: Please keep your receipt as ______ of payment in case there is a problem with your registration.
questions.explain: proof of payment 付款證明。(A) 過程、(B) 承諾、(D) 利潤，都無法當作收據的功能。

questions.prompt: Due to limited ______, only the first fifty students to register can attend the workshop.
questions.explain: 座位有限（limited seating）所以只收前五十人。(A) 演說、(B) 運送、(C) 花費，與名額限制無關。

questions.prompt: If you have any ______ about the new dormitory rules, please contact your resident assistant.
questions.explain: have concerns about 對……有疑慮，有疑慮就聯絡宿舍輔導員。(B) 概念、(C) 合約、(D) 內容，皆不符語意。

questions.prompt: Exchange students are ______ to attend the orientation; anyone who misses it cannot register for classes.
questions.explain: 缺席就不能選課，表示是「必須」參加，be required to。(A)(B) 只是邀請、歡迎，沒有強制性；(D) be pleased to 是「樂意」，主詞不對。

questions.prompt: The research team had to ______ the experiment several times because the first results were not reliable.
questions.explain: 結果不可靠，所以實驗要「重做」多次，repeat。(A) 回覆、(C) 提醒、(D) 取代，都不能搭配 experiment several times。

reading.title: Notice: Campus Network Maintenance
passage: The Information Technology Center will upgrade the campus network this weekend. From 11:00 p.m. on Saturday, November 22, to 6:00 a.m. on Sunday, November 23, Wi-Fi and wired internet will not be available in any campus building, including the dormitories.

The online learning platform and the university email system will not be affected, as they run on outside servers. However, you will need a mobile data connection to reach them during the maintenance period.

The computer labs in the library will also be closed during this time. If you have an assignment due early Sunday morning, please submit it before Saturday evening or contact your instructor in advance. Questions can be sent to itc-help@campus.edu.

questions.prompt: What will NOT be available during the maintenance?
questions.explain: 公告說所有建築（包括宿舍）的 Wi-Fi 與有線網路都不能用，故選 (B)。(A)(C) 架在外部伺服器上不受影響；(D) 行動數據反而是建議使用的方式。

questions.prompt: What are students with assignments due early Sunday morning advised to do?
options: Email the IT Center for an extension
Submit their work before Saturday evening
questions.explain: 公告建議 submit it before Saturday evening，故選 (C)。(A) 圖書館電腦教室同時關閉；(B) 要聯絡的是授課老師，不是資訊中心；(D) 沒有這樣建議。

reading.title: Midterm Exam Rooms
head: From: Dr. Sarah Lin <slin@campus.edu>
To: ECON 201 students
Subject: Midterm exam rooms and rules
passage: Dear students,

Because more students are taking ECON 201 this year, our midterm exam on Tuesday, November 25, will not be held in our usual classroom. Students whose family names begin with A to L will take the exam in Room 105, and those whose family names begin with M to Z will go to Room 210. The exam time is the same: 9:10 to 11:00.

Please arrive at least ten minutes early and bring your student ID. Calculators are allowed, but phones must be turned off and placed in your bag. If you need special arrangements, such as extra time, please email me by this Friday.
Best,
Sarah Lin

questions.prompt: Why has the exam location changed?
options: The usual classroom is being repaired.
The exam time has been moved.
There are more students in the course.
questions.explain: 信中說 Because more students are taking ECON 201 this year，故選 (D)。(A) 沒提到維修；(B) 考試時間不變；(C) 延長時間是另外申請的特殊安排，不是換教室的原因。

questions.prompt: Where should a student whose family name is Martin take the exam?
questions.explain: Martin 的姓以 M 開頭，屬於 M 到 Z，要到 Room 210，故選 (A)。(B) 是 A 到 L 的教室；(C) 這次不在原教室考。

reading.title: Text Messages
passage: Jason (2:15 p.m.): Hey, are we still meeting at the library at 4 to finish our group slides?
Nina (2:18 p.m.): About that... the library study rooms are all booked. How about the café next to the bookstore?
Jason (2:20 p.m.): It gets really noisy there after 4. What about the lounge in the Engineering Building? It's usually empty.
Nina (2:21 p.m.): Good idea, but I have a lab until 4:30. Can we make it 5 instead?
Jason (2:23 p.m.): Sure. I'll tell Mark. Can you bring the charts you made?
Nina (2:24 p.m.): Will do. See you there!

questions.prompt: Where will they most likely meet?
options: At the café next to the bookstore
questions.explain: Jason 提議工學院交誼廳，Nina 回 Good idea 並只改時間，最後說 See you there，故選 (D)。(A) 討論室已被訂滿；(B) Jason 嫌咖啡店四點後太吵；(C) 書店只是用來說明咖啡店位置。

questions.prompt: Why does Nina suggest changing the time?
options: She has a lab class until 4:30.
She needs time to make the charts.
questions.explain: Nina 說 I have a lab until 4:30，所以改到五點，故選 (B)。(A) 四點是咖啡店變吵的時間，不是打烊；(C) Mark 只是要被通知；(D) 圖表已經做好了（the charts you made）。

reading.title: Music Practice Room Reservation Form

Department: Mechanical Engineering | Club: Campus Jazz Band
Room requested: Room B | Date: Friday, December 5

reading.title: Tutors Wanted: Weekend Coding Camp
passage: The Department of Computer Science is looking for student tutors for its Weekend Coding Camp. The camp will run on four Saturdays, from January 10 to January 31, and will introduce basic programming to about sixty high school students.

Tutors will help students during hands-on sessions and answer questions in small groups. You do not need to be a computer science major, but you must have completed Introduction to Programming with a grade of B or higher. Experience working with teenagers is a plus.

Tutors will be paid NT$250 per hour and will receive a certificate of service. To apply, send a short statement explaining why you are interested, along with a copy of your transcript, to Professor Ho by December 15.

questions.prompt: Who can apply to be a tutor?
options: Students who got at least a B in Introduction to Programming
questions.explain: 條件是修過程式設計導論且成績 B 以上，故選 (D)。(A) 明說不必是資工系；(B) 服務證明是做完才拿到的，不是資格；(C) 高中生是營隊學員。

questions.prompt: What is NOT required in the application?
questions.explain: 申請只要動機短文與成績單，12 月 15 日前寄給何教授；推薦信沒有被要求，故選 (C)。(A)(B)(D) 都是文中明確列出的要求。

reading.title: Phone-Free Classrooms: One Department's Experiment
passage: Last spring, the Department of Foreign Languages tried an unusual experiment. In ten of its classes, students were asked to place their phones in a box at the front of the room at the start of each lesson. They could collect them during the break or in an emergency.

At first, many students were unhappy. "I felt nervous without my phone, especially in the first few weeks," said Allen Kuo, a second-year student. Some students also worried that they would miss important messages from their part-time employers.

By the end of the semester, however, opinions had changed. In a survey of 280 students, 64 percent said they paid more attention in class, and more than half said they took better notes. Teachers reported that discussions became more active, as students were more willing to speak up.

The results were not all positive. Average test scores in the phone-free classes rose only slightly, by about two points, compared with other classes. Professor Linda Yeh, who led the experiment, says this is not surprising. "Grades depend on many things. What we really wanted to know was whether students would feel more engaged, and they clearly did."

The department plans to continue the policy next year, but with one change: students will be allowed to keep their phones if they need them for class activities, such as looking up words in an online dictionary.

questions.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: A new app that helps students learn languages
The results of a class policy on phones
A survey about student part-time jobs
How teachers prepare for class discussions
questions.explain: 全文描述外文系「上課收手機」實驗的過程與結果，故選 (B)。(A) 線上字典只是細節；(C) 打工只在擔憂中提到；(D) 討論變熱烈是結果之一，不是主旨。

questions.prompt: Why were some students worried at the beginning?
options: They might miss messages from employers.
They could not use dictionaries during tests.
They had to pay for the phone box.
questions.explain: 第二段：worried that they would miss important messages from their part-time employers，故選 (A)。(B)(C)(D) 文中都沒有提到。

questions.prompt: What does Professor Yeh suggest about the test scores?
options: They prove that the policy failed.
They were much higher than expected.
They were not the main goal of the experiment.
They will be used to evaluate teachers.
questions.explain: 葉教授說成績受很多因素影響，真正想知道的是學生是否更投入，表示成績不是主要目的，故選 (C)。(A) 她不認為失敗；(B) 成績只小幅上升約兩分；(D) 沒有提到。

questions.prompt: What change will be made next year?
options: The policy will apply to all departments.
Phones will also be collected during breaks.
Students will be tested on note-taking.
Phones may be used for certain class activities.
questions.explain: 最後一段：課堂活動需要時（例如查線上字典）可以留著手機，故選 (D)。(A) 只說該系繼續實施；(B) 下課本來就可拿回；(C) 沒有提到。

reading.title: What a Mountain Village Taught Me
passage: When I signed up for the winter teaching program, I thought I was going to help children with their English. I didn't expect that two weeks in a small mountain village in Hualien would teach me more than any course I had taken.

Our team of six university students taught at an elementary school with only forty pupils. We had planned our lessons carefully, using slides and online videos. On the first day, however, we discovered that the school's internet connection was too slow to play anything. We had to throw away most of our plans.

That night, we sat together and rebuilt the lessons using what we had: paper, colored pens, and a box of old picture cards we found in the school library. To our surprise, the children loved the games we invented. One shy girl, who had not said a word on the first day, ended up leading her group in a spelling race.

Back on campus, I noticed that I had changed as a student, too. I used to panic when things did not go as planned, like when a group member dropped out of a project. Now I see these moments as a chance to try something new. I have also stopped depending so much on technology to study; sometimes a pen and paper help me think more clearly.
If you are thinking about joining the program next year, my advice is simple: prepare well, but be ready to let your plans go.

questions.prompt: What problem did the team face on the first day?
options: The children did not speak any English.
The internet was too slow to play videos.
questions.explain: 第二段：學校網路太慢無法播放任何東西，故選 (D)。(A) 文中沒說孩子完全不會英文；(B) 他們反而在圖書館找到字卡；(C) 沒有提到。

questions.prompt: What can be inferred about the shy girl?
options: She became more confident during the program.
She was the best English speaker in the school.
She did not enjoy the games.
She helped the team find the picture cards.
questions.explain: 她第一天一句話都不說，後來卻帶領小組進行拼字比賽，可推知她變得更有自信，故選 (A)。(B) 無法推知；(C) 與孩子們喜愛遊戲相反；(D) 字卡是團隊自己找到的。

questions.prompt: How has the writer changed as a student?
options: The writer uses more online videos to study.
The writer handles unexpected problems more calmly.
The writer studies only in the library.
questions.explain: 第四段：以前計畫出錯就驚慌，現在把它當成嘗試新事物的機會，故選 (C)。(A) 相反，作者減少依賴科技；(B) 組員退出只是舉例；(D) 沒有提到。

questions.prompt: In the last paragraph, what does "let your plans go" most likely mean?
options: Be willing to change your plans
questions.explain: 呼應第二、三段計畫被迫放棄並重新設計的經驗，let your plans go 指「願意放下、改變原本的計畫」，故選 (B)。(A)(C)(D) 都與上下文的經驗無關。

reading.title: Summer Undergraduate Research Assistant Program
passage: The Office of Research invites undergraduate students to apply for paid research assistant positions this summer. The program runs for eight weeks, from July 1 to August 26. Assistants will work with faculty members on real research projects and present a poster at Research Day in September.

Students may apply for up to two positions but will be offered only one. Applicants must have completed at least two years of study by June. Assistants who work more than 15 hours per week will also receive free summer housing in the campus dormitories.

Please note that the Ocean Plastics Survey includes fieldwork on boats, so applicants for this project must be able to swim. Applications, including a CV and one reference, are due on March 20 through the Office of Research website.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the notice?
options: To announce the winners of Research Day
To invite students to apply for summer research jobs
To explain how to write a CV
To recruit faculty members for new projects
questions.explain: 第一句：invites undergraduate students to apply for paid research assistant positions this summer，故選 (B)。(A) Research Day 是之後的海報發表；(C) CV 只是申請文件之一；(D) 招募的是學生，不是教師。

questions.prompt: Which project pays the highest hourly rate?
questions.explain: 表格中時薪最高的是 Smart Farming Sensors 的 NT$230，故選 (D)。(A) 200；(B) 210；(C) 180 是最低的。

questions.prompt: A student wants free summer housing but cannot swim. Which project is the best choice?
questions.explain: 文章說每週超過 15 小時才有免費宿舍，表格中只有海洋塑膠（20 小時）和智慧農業（18 小時）符合；海洋塑膠要求會游泳，所以選 (A)。(B) 需要會游泳；(C)(D) 每週只有 12、10 小時，沒有宿舍。

questions.prompt: What is true about the program?
options: Assistants will present a poster in September.
questions.explain: 第一段：present a poster at Research Day in September，故選 (C)。(A) 可申請兩個但只會錄取一個；(B) 計畫為期八週；(D) 須在六月前修完至少兩年。

questions.prompt: How much will an assistant on the Campus Energy Use project earn per week?
questions.explain: 表格：每週 12 小時 × 時薪 NT$210 = NT$2,520，故選 (A)。(B) 是誤用 190 元計算；(C) 是誤用 200 元；(D) 是用 16 小時計算的錯誤結果。
